title: The Insurability of Artificial Intelligence
summary_en: A mismatch exists between rapid enterprise adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) and the market for insuring it. This report examines AI incidents, lawsuits, laws, and insurance filings to assess coverage responses and accumulation risks.
